AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: ECU Vue provides generic OBD-II diagnostic readings from a user-approved diagnostic adapter. Connect in ECU Vue first. All assistant tools require the user to enable AI access and provide read-only vehicle diagnostics. Never present simulated readings as real. Cached reports include their collection time and may be stale. A code is a detected condition, not a confirmed failed part. No tool clears codes, programs an ECU, or sends arbitrary commands.
